parameters.name: createTime
parameters.description: The filter condition for the creation time of the API MCP server. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of the API MCP service.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the API MCP service.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy search by API name or exact search by API ID is supported.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The documentation language of the API MCP service. Chinese or English API documentation can be selected. Different language prompts may produce different AI response results.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of data entries to skip.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: The type of the API MCP service.

parameters.name: updateTime
parameters.description: The filter condition for the update time of the API MCP server. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.
